propositions: code_health metric is currently Python-only and language-coupled, requiring replacement with a configurable polyglot analyzer to serve non-Python client projects

current hardcoded Python readers (src/rebar, LOC-of-.py, .github/module-size-limit.txt) either fabricate authoritative zeros for absent paths or leak FileNotFoundError instead of signaling true unavailability
analyzer stack (scc/lizard/jscpd) must be packaged as optional [metrics] extra with zero new hard dependencies in rebar core; core-only install degrades to Unavailable with clear reason

analyzer interface must accept repo root + languages, return deterministic LOC/complexity/duplication signals, and emit genuine Unavailable("no analyzer configured for <lang>") rather than fabricated data or leaked exceptions
module-size cap policy must be re-expressed as optional per-project configuration layered on generic LOC signal instead of hardcoded governance artifact
